Container.Name: NexusBackup
Container.Overview: Nexus Backup is a self-contained LAN-first backup and transfer appliance for Unraid. It stores ordinary browsable files under named repositories in /backup, runs local scheduling and copy work, and provides restricted SFTP, FTP and WebDAV receiver access.
Container.Requires: Review source, backup, restore and download mappings before enabling jobs. Receiver ports use host networking: SFTP 2222 and FTP 2121. The optional remote HTTP hostname gate is an application setting, not a firewall.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Nexus configuration, database and receiver settings.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Persistent integration state and transfer staging.

Config.Name: Backup source root
Config.Description: Read-only host data visible to generic Nexus backup jobs. Point this at the specific share/directory to protect; avoid mapping the whole /mnt/user tree unless deliberately required.

Config.Name: Backup repository root
Config.Description: The single Nexus-managed storage root. Named repositories and workstation/transfer folders are ordinary files beneath it.

Config.Name: Restore staging root
Config.Description: Host staging area for restore jobs. Nexus writes only fresh generated staging directories here; restores are never in-place.

Config.Name: Transfer destination root
Config.Description: Default local destination root for managed Copyarr-style transfers. Change this to the intended import/download share.

Config.Name: FTP passive ports
Config.Description: Small passive FTP port range; forward this range if FTP is used across a routed boundary.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional explicit external http(s) origin for the Control UI/install path. This is separate from the Repository endpoint. Forwarded Host/Proto headers are intentionally ignored.
